create_inference_batcher: create an InferenceBatcher with a predict unit to batch incoming inference requests with configurable max batch size
use_inference_batcher_context_manager: use the InferenceBatcher as a context manager to automatically shutdown the executor on exit
get_batch_predict_unit: get the batch predict unit from an InferenceBatcher instance to perform batched predictions via the server handle
shutdown_inference_batcher: shutdown the InferenceBatcher executor and optionally wait for pending tasks to complete before returning
get_concurrency_backend: get a thread pool concurrency backend executor for running ASE calculations concurrently with configurable options
